daily-ai-briefing.prompt: Search the web for latest AI/ML research from past 24 hours. Focus: LLM reasoning, agent frameworks, transformer improvements, open-weight models. Find 5+ recent papers/articles from: arXiv, major labs (Nous, Anthropic, Google, Meta), top conferences. Summarize top 3 most important with: clear headline, 2-sentence technical summary, source URL, confidence level (High/Med/Low), why it matters for practitioner. Format as clean briefing with 📌 emoji sections. End with story count. If <3 quality items, respond [SILENT].

weekly-paper-digest.prompt: Search arXiv for papers from past 7 days on: 1) 'language model reasoning' OR 'chain of thought' (cat:cs.CL OR cs.AI OR cs.LG), 2) 'agent framework' OR 'tool use' OR 'function calling' (cat:cs.AI OR cs.SE), 3) 'transformer efficiency' OR 'Mixture of Experts' OR 'attention optimization' (cat:cs.LG OR cs.CL). For each category, select top 3 by relevance. For each paper: create Obsidian note in 'Research/Papers/' with title, authors, arXiv ID, submission date, abstract summary (3-5 sentences), key contribution, methodology highlight, code availability (GitHub link if present). Use arxiv + obsidian skills. Deliver summary to local.
